classes: Three faction realms as a fixed set of slots (src/craft_recipes.cpp:240-254); names not copied
No character classes or races in the repo; progression shape: none
Craft professions: 19, each with 200 category slots (src/craft_recipes.cpp:15-16, 140-144, 273); a crafting progression, not classes
gear_tiers: Craft tier gate: skill level plus item level plus material level on each recipe (include/daoc_client_lib/craft_recipes.h:21-30; material_level read at src/craft_recipes.cpp:50)
Ingredients name a base material and a count, and may point to a sub-recipe (include/daoc_client_lib/craft_recipes.h:11-18)
Zone types as a tier-like set: terrain, city, dungeon, sky city (include/daoc_client_lib/zone_geometry.h:18-24)
zones: Zone types: terrain (0), city (1), dungeon (2), sky city (4) (include/daoc_client_lib/zone_geometry.h:18-24); type set from zone data (src/zone_geometry_chooser.cpp:38)
Zone as a data bundle: one package per zone (src/zone_geometry.cpp:19) with one loader per table (src/zone_geometry.cpp:130-201, per the AU006 audit)
Zone exits as rows: JumpPoint with position, heading and extra zone ids (include/daoc_client_lib/jump_point.h:12-22; include/daoc_client_lib/zone_records.h:12)
Terrain height from a per-zone PCX image (src/zone_geometry.cpp:201; include/daoc_client_lib/terrain_height_map.h:11)
Water as a separate geometry layer (include/daoc_client_lib/dungeon_water.h:17-22; include/daoc_client_lib/river_geometry.h:13-19)
Tree replacement clusters per zone with bark and leaf textures (include/daoc_client_lib/tree_replacement_map.h:12-22; src/tree_replacement_map.cpp:107-119)
